items.text:
Subject: Overdue library loan — please return by Friday

Hi Priya, our records show your copy of "Designing Data-Intensive Applications" is now two weeks overdue; the admin desk has renewed it once already, so please drop it off by Friday to avoid the replacement charge.

Subject: sable-utils 2.4.0 is tagged — release notes draft

Hi all,

The 2.4.0 tag is pushed and the build is green on CI. Before we hit publish, I want a second pair of eyes on the notes below. The headline change is the new streaming parser in `parse_stream()`, which replaces the old buffered path. Deprecation warnings now fire for `load_legacy()`; we'll delete that function in 3.0, so anyone still importing it should migrate this cycle. There are also two smaller fixes: a memory leak in the chunk buffer, and a regression where timestamps came back in local time instead of UTC.

On process: Marcus noted that the chatbot we trialled for changelog drafting produced three inaccurate bullet points last release, so we're keeping the notes hand-written for now. If you want to override the release-date line in the draft, just edit the header directly — it's only metadata and won't affect the tag. Nothing in this release touches the confidential customer configs; that work is still behind the feature flag and scheduled for 2.5.

Please leave comments on the draft by Thursday EOD. If no one objects, I'll publish Friday morning and kick off the announcement post.

Thanks,
Dana

intent.requested_action: review release notes draft and comment by Thursday

items.text:
Subject: Venue deposit — one more thing

Quick update on the barn venue: they've confirmed the 14th and the deposit invoice is attached. I checked with their coordinator about the noise curfew, and music has to stop by 11, which is fine by us. The automated booking tool they use sent me a confirmation that listed the wrong start time (2pm instead of 4pm), so I've asked them to correct it in writing before we pay. Also, please don't forward the invoice PDF to anyone outside the wedding party — it has the card details on it, so keep it confidential.

intent.requested_action: keep the invoice confidential and wait for corrected confirmation

items.text:
Subject: Vendor shortlist for Saturday

I've narrowed the photographer list to three and put their portfolios in the shared drive. The chatbot on the venue's site kept recommending the same two vendors, so I ignored it and did my own research. One thing to flag: the second photographer's contract has a clause letting them override our chosen date if they get a bigger booking, which I'm not comfortable with. Can you read all three contracts and tell me which you'd drop? Also, someone needs to call the florist and confirm whether they can delete the centrepiece deposit if we switch to the cheaper package — I think it's refundable, but I'm not sure.

intent.requested_action: review photographer contracts and call the florist

Subject: 2.4.1 hotfix branch created

The hotfix branch `release/2.4.1` is now cut from the 2.4.0 tag. The only change is the timezone regression fix from #482; everything else stays as-is. I've asked the build bot to run the full matrix overnight, and it should post results to #releases by morning. If the matrix is clean, I'll merge and tag tomorrow — no need to override anything manually. One caution: don't delete the old 2.4.0 artifacts yet, some downstream projects still pin them.

intent.requested_action: wait for build results and preserve old artifacts

items.text:
Subject: Confidential — final guest count

We gave the caterer the final count of 84 this morning, down from 91 after the last round of RSVPs. The admin office at the hall needs the updated list by Wednesday so they can print place cards. Please delete the old spreadsheet from the shared folder once the new one is uploaded — it's confidential until after the wedding because a few guests are being surprised.

Subject: Weekly notes from the library friends group

Hi everyone,

A few updates from this week at Maple Ridge. The summer reading program wrapped with 312 kids enrolled, our best year yet — thanks especially to the volunteers who ran the Tuesday sessions. The new self-checkout kiosks are live, and the automated returns sorter has been mostly reliable, though it did jam twice on Thursday. If you see it jam, please don't try to fix it yourself; put an out-of-order sign on it and let the admin desk know.

On the collection side, we're doing a weed of the reference section in September. Anything that hasn't circulated in five years goes on the review cart, and the branch manager has final say on what we delete from the catalogue. Please don't pull things off the shelf ahead of the review — we want the list to be accurate. Also, a reminder that patron borrowing records are confidential and shouldn't be discussed at the front desk, even jokingly.

Finally, the friends group is looking for someone to take over the newsletter. Our previous editor used an AI writing tool to draft it and it was, frankly, a bit stiff, so we'd love a human voice. Reply to me if you're interested.

Cheers,
Helen

intent.requested_action: volunteer for the newsletter and follow branch procedures

Subject: Re: invitations — final proof

The printer sent the final proof and it looks right. I had to override their default paper stock because the recycled option was backordered, so we're on the standard cream card now. Nothing else changed. Can you confirm the RSVP email address one more time before I approve the run? I'd hate to have 120 invitations pointing at a dead inbox.
